name: Pabbly Email Marketing
line: Email campaigns, subscriber workflows and API-triggered sends.

free.text: Free for 100 contacts; duration listed as 30 days or ongoing

cells.api: Yes, REST API can send a saved campaign

subs.math: $19 Standard plan + 4,000 emails × $0.10 per 1,000 through Amazon SES, pay as you go = $19.40. Four campaign days need a 1,000-a-day quota, before tax.
$19 Standard plan + 20,000 emails × $0.10 per 1,000 through Amazon SES, pay as you go = $21. Four campaign days need a 5,000-a-day quota, before tax.
$19 Standard plan + 40,000 emails × $0.10 per 1,000 through Amazon SES, pay as you go = $23. Four campaign days need a 10,000-a-day quota, before tax.
$79 base plan + 200,000 emails × $0.10 per 1,000 through Amazon SES, pay as you go = $99. Requires approval for 50,000 contacts and enough sender quota.
